# DS Bot English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v0.3_preview-blue) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.2--rc.1-4D6BFE) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache_2.0-green) **[Download DS Bot for Windows 10/11 (64-bit) / 下载 Windows 10/11（64 位）版](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases/latest)**, about 212 MB / 约 212 MB. A community project, not an official DeepSeek product. / 社区开源项目，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。 On that page, download `DS-Bot--win-x64.exe`. Double-click it to install; DS Bot opens when it is done. No administrator rights, no Node or DSH needed. You need a DeepSeek account (you can sign up with a phone number on the spot) or a DeepSeek API key. DeepSeek bills by usage: see [its prices](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing). For macOS, Linux or the DSH plugin, see [Install](README.md#install). 在这个页面下载 `DS-Bot-<版本>-win-x64.exe`，双击就会安装，装好自动打开。不用管理员权限，不用另装 Node 或 DSH。需要一个 DeepSeek 账号（可以当场用手机号注册）或 DeepSeek API Key。DeepSeek 按用量收费，见[价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing)。macOS、Linux 和 DSH 插件见[安装](README.zh.md#安装)。
The browser or Windows warns you, or blocks the installer? / 浏览器或 Windows 提示、拦下了安装包？ The installer is not signed yet, so Windows does not know its publisher. - Edge says the file is not commonly downloaded: **···** → **Keep** → **Show more** → **Keep anyway**. - "Windows protected your PC": **More info** → **Run anyway**. - "Smart App Control blocked …", with no **Run anyway**: there is no safe way around this for an unsigned installer. Use [DSH Desktop with the DS Bot plugin](README.md#install) instead. Do not turn Smart App Control off. - An antivirus blocks it: check the file first. In Command Prompt, run `certutil -hashfile SHA256` and compare the result with the file's line in `SHA256SUMS.txt` on the release page. If they match, choose to trust the file in the antivirus. - The installer says it could not uninstall the old version: close DS Bot and run the installer again. If your antivirus stopped the installer, check and trust it as above first. Still stuck? [Report an install problem](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/new?template=install.yml). 安装包还没有签名，所以 Windows 认不出发布者。 - Edge 提示「不常下载」：「···」→「保留」→「显示更多」→「仍然保留」。 - 「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。 - 「智能应用控制已阻止…」，而且没有「仍要运行」：未签名的安装包没有安全的绕过办法，请改用 [DSH Desktop 加 DS Bot 插件](README.zh.md#安装)。不要关掉智能应用控制。 - 杀毒软件拦截：先核对文件。在命令提示符里运行 `certutil -hashfile <文件> SHA256`，和 Release 页上 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 里这个文件的那一行比较，一致后再在杀毒软件里选「信任」。 - 安装时提示卸载旧版失败：先关掉 DS Bot，再运行一次安装包。杀毒软件拦了安装包时，先按上面的方法核对，选「信任」。 还是装不上？[报告安装问题](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/issues/new?template=install.yml)。
